messages:
Maria Chen: Hey CS team — scheduling a compact async-friendly enablement drop-in for a couple high-priority onboardings (esp Nimbus Health). Goal: 30m focused session: quick migration checklist run + failure modes + Q&A.

Devon Li: I can cover the migration checklist. Tue 10:00–10:30 PT works for me. I'll prep a 8–10 slide deck.

Aj Patel: I can host & take notes. Tue is good. Can we add a short section on common failures (OOM, KV-cache warmup)? :+1:

Samir Rao: Wed 16:00 CET is better for EMEA but I can watch recording. +1 on failure modes and add a canary rollout demo.

Maria Chen: OK — plan: Tue session primary (live). Devon runs checklist, Aj hosts/notes, Samir records canary demo (or live if Wed). Who can create the invite and add pre-reads/feedback link?

Devon Li: I'll upload slides to the shared folder: https://drive.redwood.com/rel/migration-checklist-v2

Aj Patel: I'll create the Zoom + calendar. @enable-bot please spin up invite for Tue 10:00 PT and attach recording toggle.

enable-bot: Created event https://calendar.redwood.com/event/abc123 — invites sent to Maria Chen, Devon Li, Aj Patel, Samir Rao. Zoom link attached.

Aj Patel: Agenda added to invite:
1) 5m intro
2) 10m migration checklist runthrough (Devon)
3) 10m failure modes & mitigation (Aj + Samir)
4) 5m live Q&A

Maria Chen: Please add the feedback form to the event: https://forms.redwood.com/enablement-feedback

Aj Patel: Done. Also asked CS reps to bring account-specific blockers (migration errors, data residency, SLA asks).

Devon Li: Dropping pre-read file name: `migration-checklist-v2.pdf` and a 3-step demo script in the folder.

Samir Rao: If turnout is low, we flip to async: post recording + thread and run an office-hours follow-up. I'll set up the canary demo recording tomorrow.

Maria Chen: I'll ping the Nimbus Health AMs to RSVP and surface any high-risk tickets beforehand. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
